en: No one wanted to believe it was real, but Rantaro was killed just before the time limit. Now, Kaede and Shuichi must take on the Class Trial.
Tragedy strikes during Himiko's magic show, and Ryoma is killed. Shuichi must now complete the new trial to fulfill Kaede's wish.
In an attempt to resurrect the dead, Angie is killed. During a seance to search for answers, Tenko is killed. Are the two related? The third trial begins!
The students enter a virtual world to try to find the "truth of the outside world," but somehow Miu is killed. This trial blends a virtual world with the real world!
Unified against the mastermind, Kokichi, the students must survive a Class Trial without knowing the murderer or the victim. An unpredictable trial begins...
Keebo and the Exisals have turned the academy into a war zone, and Shuichi challenges Monokuma to a final class trial. Can they put an end to the killing game!?
Despite Kaede's solemn wish, the killing game has begun. Who killed the Ultimate Clairvoyant? What will be Kaede's fate!? The Class Trial begins now!
